title: Smoothness of an algebra is invariant under isomorphism of algebras
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $A$ and $B$ be commutative $R$-algebras, and let $\alpha:A\to B$ be an isomorphism of $R$-algebras (a ring isomorphism with $\alpha(r\cdot 1_A)=r\cdot 1_B$ for all $r\in R$). If $R\to A$ is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], then $R\to B$ is a smooth ring map.
